title: Weil partners with Google Cloud to deploy AI platform for legal services
description: Weil Gotshal has adopted Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise for Legal, becoming one of the first law firms to do so. The firm, with roughly 1,200 lawyers, pairs the platform with in-house tools like BenchMark to avoid relying on a single AI vendor.

title: Cisco just broke its biggest hardware rule to chase the AI boom
